About Me

The story behind
@oyindababz

I create story-driven content centered around faith-led living, motherhood, lifestyle, and financial growth. My platform resonates with millennial women navigating real-life transitions — from debt reset to wealth building, from career shifts to motherhood.

Beyond social platforms, I'm the founder of the Busy Mamas Network — a growing community for millennial immigrant moms in Canada focused on connection, financial growth, and intentional living. I lead a paid Money Club of 200+ engaged members actively implementing structured financial systems and wealth-building strategies.
